title: 11eNexus
homeHelp: Pick a game to join its channel, bring a paused game back or choose your notifications.
panelPlayHelp: Active games are open to Syndiqué members. Visit the archives to bring an old channel back.
panelNotificationsHelp: Choose the games you want mentions for. You can change your mind at any time.
panelAddHelp: Missing a game? Search its name, check the right edition and confirm its addition.
personalMenuHint: Buttons open a menu only you can see.
browseHelp_active: Choose a game to open its channel or receive notifications. Want something else? Check the archives.
browseHelp_archived: These games are paused and their history is preserved. Choose one, then use Bring this game back to reopen its channel.
browseHelp_all: Every catalogue game is here. Choose a game or search a name, including archived games.
browseHelp_subscribed: These are the games you receive mentions for. Open a game to turn them off; use All to choose more.
chooseGameHelp: Open the list below and choose the game you’re interested in.
emptySearchHelp: No matching games. Try another name or use Add a game to look for a new entry.
emptyHelp_active: No active games right now. Open the archives to bring one back.
emptyHelp_archived: No paused games right now. Open channels are listed under Active games.
emptyHelp_all: The catalogue is empty for now. You can search for a game to add.
emptyHelp_subscribed: You haven’t chosen any notifications yet. Open All, choose a game and enable its notifications.
gameHelp_active: The channel is open: join the conversation whenever you like. You can read it without enabling notifications.
gameHelp_archived: This game is paused. To play again, you can bring its channel back to the active games.
gameHelp_unavailable: The team needs to check this game before it can be brought back.
gameNeedsHelp: An administrator needs to check this game. You can return to the catalogue and choose another one.
subscriptionHelp: Subscribing gives you game mentions; it does not change channel access.
quotaPending: The team needs to check one of your previous actions before another addition or revival.
candidateConfirmHelp: Is this the right game? Check the studio and edition before confirming.
candidateImageHelp: The image could not be prepared. Choose another entry or send the game to the team.
noCandidateHelp: No usable entries for this search. Try another name or propose the game to the team.
manualRequestHelp: Can’t find the right entry? Send its name and an official link to the team; follow the reply under My requests.
adminRequestsHelp: Open a request to check the game, inspect its link and prepare a reply to the member.
requestsHelp: Find the games you proposed to the team. Open a request to read the reply or add missing information.
noAdminRequests: No requests to review right now.
noRequestsHelp: You have no requests yet. Search for your game first; if no entry fits, you can propose it to the team.
requestHelp_pending: Your request is saved. The team will check the game; you can find their reply here.
requestHelp_needs_info: The team needs more information. Read the reason, then update your request using the button below.
requestHelp_accepted: The game was approved. Open its page to find the channel, bring it back or choose notifications.
requestHelp_rejected: The team did not approve this request. Read the reason below, then return to your other games.
modalBackHint: Close this window to return to the menu. Nothing is sent until you submit.
searchModalHelp: Search every game on the server, including the archives.
addSearchModalHelp: Search for the game to add. If the server already has it, you’ll find its page.
requestModalHelp: Give the game’s name and an official link to help the team find the right edition.
amendModalHelp: Update the information using the clarification requested by the team.
notifyModalHelp: Your message will be posted in the game channel with a mention of its subscribers.
gameNameHint: The game name is enough. Include its edition if needed.
officialLinkHint: An official or store page starting with https://.
notifyFieldHint: Suggest a session: time, open spots, plans…
gameAlreadyHere: This game is already in the catalogue: you can use its page directly.
resourceAuditDefinition: Tracking is checked by ID in SQLite, even when names differ. Untracked means no known association, not unused: check subscriber counts and listed references. Resources from retired games or unfinished operations are identified separately. This report does not modify Discord.
resourceAuditRenameHint: Suggestions follow the catalogue name. Review before any renaming script; no names have been changed.
catalogueSummary: {{total}} games in the catalogue · {{active}} active · {{archived}} archived
catalogueFilterHint: Use the Archived filter to find and bring back other games.
archiveHint: Bringing this game back makes its channel visible to the community. Without a new human message within 48 hours, it returns to the archives.
candidate: Select the exact game; check its studio and release information.
confirmCreate: Add {{game}} to the server? A visible channel will be created. Without a first human message in 48 hours it will return to the archives.
requestRecorded: Your proposal for {{game}} is recorded. An administrator will verify its identity and image.
notificationSent: The game role has been mentioned in its channel.
recycledHint: Your preference is saved. The notification role will be restored when the game returns.
adminStatus: {{games}} games · {{pending}} pending proposals · {{operations}} operations requiring review
proposalAlert: A game proposal needs review: {{game}}. Use /nexus-admin proposals.
partial: An operation for {{game}} needs review. Check /nexus-admin status before retrying.
capacityAlert: Archiving {{game}} is blocked by capacity or permissions. Administrative action is required.
activityUnavailable: Activity could not be fully checked for {{game}}; automatic archiving is skipped.
forbidden: You need the Syndiqué role to use this panel.
adminOnly: This action is reserved for administrators.
notFound: This item no longer exists. Open the panel again.
invalidInput: Check the information entered and try again.
catalogueUnavailable: New game search is temporarily unavailable. You can still use known games or submit a proposal with an official link.
invalidImage: This image cannot be used. An administrator can verify the proposal or select a parent game’s icon.
needsReview: An administrator needs to verify this game or its icon. Submit a proposal or contact the team.
cooldown: You can create or bring back another game in {{minutes}} minutes.
proposalCooldown: You already submitted a proposal in the last 24 hours. Check its status under My proposals.
notificationCooldown: Please wait before using Notify players again for this game.
mentionHint: To notify subscribers, mention {{role}} directly in the conversation.
capacity: There is no room for this action. An administrator must free up space; no new game has been announced as ready.
iconsUnavailable: Role icons are unavailable on this server. An administrator needs to review this action.
incomplete: Discord could not be fully checked. No destructive reconciliation has been performed.
inProgress: An operation is already in progress. Please check the game again shortly.
blocked: This game is currently unavailable for this action. Contact an administrator.
discordError: Discord did not confirm this action. Please check the result before trying again.
configuration: The server configuration needs an administrator’s attention.
expired: This personal panel has expired. Open 11eNexus again.
archiveFirst: Archive or make this game unavailable before retiring it from the catalogue.
noMentions: Adding or bringing back a game does not automatically subscribe you or mention its players.
quotaHint: One creation or reactivation per member in 24 hours.
approveHint: Use /nexus-admin approve and choose this proposal by name, with an icon attachment or parent game.
manualReview: Check the game’s title, official link and image. No public channel has been created yet.
migrationRequired: No games are imported automatically. An administrator must prepare and apply an import plan.
searchLimited: Please wait before searching the external catalogue again.
setupHint: Administrators publish and configure this panel. Members manage their own games and notifications.
unknownError: This action could not be completed. The team can check the diagnostic logs.
panelIntro: Find a game, choose your notifications or bring an old game back.
catalogueCapacity: Nexus catalogue, channel or role capacity has been reached. An administrator must free up space.
duplicateGame: A game with this name already exists. Check the catalogue or ask an administrator to clarify its identity.
alreadyProposed: This game has already been proposed and is awaiting administrator review.
requestUpdated: Your proposal has been updated. The team can resume its review.
importReviewIntro: Choose the channels and roles to adopt. Straightforward matches can be selected together; duplicates, campaigns and special permissions need a decision. This local page does not modify Discord.
importReviewScope: Only these two categories are analysed
importReviewArchiveExplanation: The standby category becomes the first hidden archive. All its textual channels will be hidden, including channels excluded from the catalogue. History is preserved. Archives 2 and 3 are created only when necessary, at 50 channels per category.
importReviewCounts: {{channels}} textual channels to review · {{ignored}} non-textual spaces ignored.
importReviewOnboarding: Remove imported game references from onboarding after importing subscriptions
importReviewExportHint: Download the manifest, then use the plan command. Permissions and role hierarchy are rechecked on Discord before applying anything. Choose RAWG references explicitly; no same-name result is selected automatically.
importReviewMissing: A name or role choice is missing.
importReviewInvalidRawg: The RAWG reference is invalid or used twice.
importReviewEmpty: Select at least one channel to export.
importReviewSelected: {{count}} game(s) selected. The manifest is ready for verification with the plan command.
importIssueunmatched: No role identified: choose an existing role or let Nexus create one for this game.
importIssuefuzzy: Suggested match: check the game name and role.
importIssueduplicate: Several channels share the proposed role: choose the canonical channel or separate the games.
importIssueevent: Possible campaign or temporary space: preserved, review before inclusion.
importIssuefamily: Grouped games or a series: choose one game identity.
importIssuepermissions: This role has global permissions; the plan will reject its import in this state.
importIssuehierarchy: The role is above the bot: move the bot up before applying.
importIssuereferences: The role is used in channel permissions; review those access rules.
importIssuecatalogueUnavailable: RAWG search failed; other matches remain available.
importReviewCreateRole: Create a role for this game
importReviewNewRoleHint: The role is created when applying the plan, with no global permissions or initial subscribers. Choose a RAWG game or reuse a parent game role’s icon below.
importReviewRawgIcon: Use the selected RAWG game image
importReviewIconRequired: To create the role, choose a RAWG game or a parent role with an icon.
